deployments_detail.use: Oracle Digital Assistant: conversational AI platform (text/chat/voice) that unifies purpose-built chatbots for enterprise application interactions and customer/employee self-service across Oracle apps. [Oracle Digital Assistant]

Oracle Code Assist: AI code companion running on OCI, fine-tuned/optimized for Java, SuiteScript, PL/SQL and Oracle Cloud; provides code generation, real-time bug flags and suggested fixes to boost developer velocity. [Oracle Code Assist (OCI)]

Autonomous Database Select AI: natural-language-to-SQL feature that lets users query the Oracle Autonomous Database in plain language, with LLM integration and retrieval-augmented generation over enterprise data. [Oracle Autonomous Database + LLMs (OCI GenAI, OpenAI, Cohere)]
OCI GPU AI infrastructure + AI Database; RPO/backlog surged (reported ~$455B+) on AI cloud contracts (incl. OpenAI/Stargate)

Oracle Health Clinical AI Agent: a multimodal voice/generative-AI assistant that captures patient conversations, drafts clinical notes, generates coding suggestions, and (as of 2026) creates orders inside the EHR. Built on the Oracle Digital Assistant platform. [Oracle Digital Assistant / Oracle generative AI]
deployments_detail.value: Saved doctors more than 200,000 hours of documentation time; ~30% reduction in daily documentation time per physician

deployments_detail.use: Fusion Agentic Applications and AI Agent Studio: embedded, configurable AI agents across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP/HCM/SCM/CX that reason and take action on business workflows, with a partner agent marketplace and support for multiple LLMs. [Oracle AI Agent Studio (multi-LLM)]

OCI Generative AI service: managed platform serving pretrained foundation models (Cohere Command, Meta Llama 3/4, and hosted xAI Grok) for enterprise generative AI, with tool/function calling and fine-tuning. [Cohere, Meta Llama, xAI Grok on OCI]
xAI Grok models on OCI Generative AI: xAI selected Oracle to host and serve Grok 3 / Grok 3 Mini models via OCI in a dedicated xAI tenancy for enterprise use cases. [xAI Grok]

Oracle AI Vector Search in Oracle Database 23ai: generate, store, index and query vector embeddings alongside business data for semantic similarity search and grounded RAG generation over enterprise data. [Oracle Database 23ai]
Generative AI enhancements across 100+ workflows in finance, HR, supply chain [Cohere]

Payables Agent / Document IO in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: GenAI-powered invoice ingestion agent that extracts, labels, and maps invoice fields from image/text across supplier formats for touchless accounts-payable / procure-to-pay processing (superseding legacy IDR). [Oracle Fusion AI (Document IO)]

Generative AI in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Recruiting: AI Assist generates candidate work summaries from resumes, matches candidates to job openings, and powers a conversational HCM career coach on recruiting career sites. [Oracle Fusion HCM generative AI]

NetSuite AI: generative-AI features embedded across the ERP suite including SuiteAnalytics Assistant (natural-language reporting), Text Enhance (email/description generation), Narrative Insights (auto record/report summaries) and anomaly detection. [Oracle NetSuite generative AI]
Order processing assistant for creating, canceling, and modifying orders
AI agents for supply chain management with traditional and generative AI capabilities

Oracle AI Agents for Customer Experience (CX): agentic and generative AI embedded across Fusion Cloud Marketing, Sales and Service to draft content, generate assisted answers, guide sellers and surface revenue opportunities. [Oracle Fusion CX AI]
